sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a SONS OF BEHEMAT army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for SONS OF BEHEMAT units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Pick an Archetype.
4. Pick an origin and/or flaw.
5. Pick an Infamous Moniker.
6. Pick an Infamous Epithet.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Runt | 5 | 150
Oaf | 25 | 250
Little Heel | 45 | 350
Big Heel | 10 | 400
If you picked a Runt, Oaf or Little Heel, your hero must be represented by a model mounted on a 90×72mm oval base or 90mm round base. If you picked a Big Heel, your hero must be represented by a model mounted on a 130mm round base or larger.
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 2 - Fill Out the Starting Warscroll
sections.text: If you picked a Runt, Oaf or Little Heel, your hero starts with a Bullstomper Hero warscroll. If you picked a Big Heel, your hero starts with a Mega-Gargant Hero warscroll.

sections.name: Step 3 - Pick an Archetype
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:
BOSSY
0DP
Your hero has the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SONS OF BEHEMAT units
LEGGY
-2DP
Add 2" to your hero’s Move characteristic, and your hero has the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SONS OF BEHEMAT units
CREEPY
-4DP
Your hero has the WIZARD (1) keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SONS OF BEHEMAT units
HOLY (FOR A GARGANT)
-4DP
Your hero has the PRIEST (1) keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SONS OF BEHEMAT units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick an Origin and/or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Passive
-1DP
BRODD’S DISCIPLE
Effect: Add 2 to rampage rolls for this unit while they are within 3" of any enemy faction terrain features.
Deployment Phase
-2DP
OUTRAGED COLLECTOR
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO to be the target. You can pick a unit in reserve.
Effect: For the rest of the battle, each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll or 1 wound roll for this unit’s attacks that target that enemy HERO.
Passive
-4DP
ANGRY DRUNK
Effect: If any damage points are allocated to this unit as a result of a FIGHT ability used by an enemy unit this turn and this unit is in combat with that enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit after that FIGHT ability has been resolved.
Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a command for this unit
-6DP
ACTUALLY... SMART?
Effect: Pick another visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit wholly within 12" of this unit that has not used a command this phase to use the same command immediately after the first has been resolved (this is an exception to Commands, 1.2). You must still spend command points as normal to use the command a second time.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+2DP
BIG BODY, SMALL MIND
Effect: This unit cannot use commands other than the ‘All-out Attack’ command.
Passive
+2DP
FANTASTICALLY CLUMSY
Effect: Each time you make a run roll of 1 for this unit as part of a Run ability:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit
That Run ability has no effect.

+3DP
WALKING WOUNDED
Effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any other MONSTERS (friendly or enemy), this unit cannot use RAMPAGE abilities.
Passive
+5DP

Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is within 12" of and visible to any friendly units.

sections.name: Step 5 - Pick An Infamous Moniker
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Infamous Moniker for your hero. This is a title that your hero has earned through their deeds, e.g. if their name is Krunk, they could be known as Stompin’ Krunk or Krunk the Mountain.

sections.text:

sections.name: Path Of The Footslogger
sections.text:
(LITTLE units only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BRASH
Effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
HOP, SKIP AND A JUMP
Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can pass through models in non- MONSTER units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Shooting Phase
CAREFUL LOBBING
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
Passive
TOUGHING IT OUT
Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
BRUTAL BEATDOWN
Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
SMACK TALK
Declare: Pick an enemy non- MONSTER unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, carry out the following for them:
GOT BIG
Replace this unit’s warscroll with the Mega-Gargant Hero starting warscroll and mount the model on a 130mm round base or larger. If this unit has more than 1 model, change its unit size to 1 (the other models are removed). If this unit is an Anvil of Apotheosis hero, it keeps its Archetype, origin, flaw, Infamous Moniker, Infamous Epithet and any upgrades. Remove each rank ability gained by this unit from this Path, then this unit embarks on the Path of the Heel at the Aspiring rank.
Designer’s Note: Yes, this does allow you to turn a Mancrusher Gargant into a Mega-Gargant! You could also turn a whole unit of 3 Boss-stompers or Rock-hurlers into 1 Mega-Gargant too; probably not the best use of this mechanic, but we wanted you to be able to tell that story if you wanted to. You could come up with a fun reason as to where the other 2 gargants went!

sections.name: Path Of The Heel
sections.text:
(BIG units only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
GALLOPING LOUT
Effect: You can re-roll run rolls for this unit.
End of Any Turn
AVATAR OF GHYRAN
Effect: Heal (1) this unit.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Any Charge Phase
SMASHY
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is a MONSTER, inflict D6 mortal damage on it instead.
Your Charge Phase
EAGER
Declare: Pick the nearest visible enemy unit to this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
This unit must end charge moves within ½" of the target.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SPELL-GOBBLER
Effect: If this unit is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, while it is within 3" of a Place of Power or wholly within enemy territory, it can use Unbind and BANISH abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). Otherwise, add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for this unit while it is within 3" of a Place of Power.
Once Per Battle (Army), Any HERO Phase
AWFUL PROMISE
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible enemy HEROES within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for each target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BEHEMAT’S FURY
Effect: Each time an attack made with this unit’s Almighty Stomp scores a critical hit, that attack scores 2 hits on the target unit instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit. In addition, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, those attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+.
Passive
GHYRANITE BASTION
Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D6) this unit.
